results.snippet: When that someone is a human adjuster working a queue of hundreds of open files, errors accumulate and cycle times stretch. This guide covers how FNOL works, where the process stalls, and how AI is enabling insurers to cut intake cycle times while improving data accuracy and regulatory compliance.
